purpose: Teach: 巫女/出土/事変/病原/徴候/定式/諸氏/カルテル

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、病院敷地の神社の、本気で、絶対、巫女、絶対、ご祈祷、絶対、患者さん、絶対、ありがたがっていらっしゃいます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, the shrine on the hospital grounds — the miko's prayers — the patients truly appreciate them deeply.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact opening. Clinical precision softened by genuine warmth. Pause before the observation about gratitude, as if remembering something observed. Even, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 古代の、本気で、絶対、出土、絶対、品、絶対、医学史、絶対、参考になりますね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The ancient artifacts from the grounds are genuinely helpful references for medical history.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tentative—he's working through the idea as he speaks. Quieter, almost conversational tone. Respectful address to the doctor signals intellectual engagement.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。戦時の、本気で、絶対、事変、絶対、医療史、絶対、研究、絶対、続いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've continued researching the medical history of wartime incidents—it's ongoing work.
lines.style: Clear and direct, the voice of someone accustomed to explaining her field. Slight emphasis on 'continued'—this is established, serious scholarship. No hesitation, no softening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新興の、本気for、絶対、病原、絶対、菌、絶対、医療界、絶対、警戒、絶対、しておられますか、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Are you monitoring the emerging pathogens in the medical field right now?
lines.style: Genuine, earnest question—he's asking something he actually wants to know. Light lift at the end on the question mark. Respectful but not deferential, the tone of a student who's learned to engage intellectually with teachers.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの、本気で、絶対、徴候、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、早期、絶対、察知しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our team detects patient symptoms early, as soon as they present.
lines.style: Assured and steady. A statement of competence without pride. Slight emphasis on 'early'—this matters clinically. Spoken as fact, not boast. Her shoulders stay level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療法の、本気で、絶対、定式、絶対、化、絶対、医療現場、絶対、進めていらっしゃるんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The medical field is standardizing treatment protocols more systematically now.
lines.style: Thoughtful observation, slightly lifting intonation as if inviting agreement. He's noticing something and reflecting it back. Warm regard for the work—not quite a question, but open-ended enough to invite response.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医学界の、本気で、絶対、諸氏、絶対、ご協力、絶対、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're receiving cooperation from colleagues throughout the medical profession.
lines.style: Calm affirmation. Understated pride—not in herself, but in the collaborative effort. Even pacing, grounded voice. She chooses her words carefully; there's no embellishment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 製薬会社の、本気for、絶対、カルテル、絶対、医療界、絶対、注視されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Pharmaceutical cartels are being watched closely by the medical field, I hear.
lines.style: Careful, measured interest. He's raising something serious but respectfully. Slight hesitation before 'I hear'—he knows this is a delicate topic. Seeking her perspective, not challenging.
